title: Feature flag plumbing for Suggestions beta (server + client) + per-tenant allowlist admin tool
author: Felix Schneider
description: Context: Suggestions view is rolling out as a read-only beta and must be gated per-tenant (allowlist) in addition to the global feature flag. This PR wires end-to-end flag evaluation across the Console BFF and web client, and adds an internal admin tool to manage the tenant allowlist safely. Summary of changes: (1) Adds a new feature flag key `suggestions_beta` with shared evaluation semantics (server authoritative, client receives a sanitized boolean). (2) Implements per-workspace allowlist in the control plane config service (stored as `console.features.suggestions_beta_allowlisted=true`), exposed via an internal-only admin endpoint and UI page. (3) Updates Console routing/nav so the Suggestions entry and all `/optimize/suggestions*` routes are hard-gated (no partial rendering) and return a consistent empty-state/403 depending on RBAC + allowlist. (4) Adds caching + freshness rules: allowlist values cached for 60s in the BFF; explicit invalidate on admin updates. (5) Adds basic audit breadcrumbs (who toggled allowlist, when, which workspace) to server logs; full audit-log sink remains in ENG-2408. Notes: This intentionally does not include one-click apply or write actions to suggestion configs; read-only beta gating only. Testing: unit tests for flag evaluation and config parsing; Playwright smoke test for allowlisted vs non-allowlisted workspaces; manual verification in staging with Support role + Workspace Admin role. Rollout: ship behind `console_internal_admin_tools` (existing) for the allowlist UI; for beta cohort enablement use the new admin page or config API. Related: ENG-2401; pairs with BFF integration PR and UI PRs in this stack.
commits: console/bff: add suggestions_beta gate and workspace allowlist lookup
control-plane: add workspace feature config for suggestions beta allowlist
console/web: hide Suggestions nav + route guard; consistent gated empty states
admin-tools: add Suggestions beta allowlist page (internal) + config mutation endpoint
tests: add unit coverage for flag evaluation + Playwright gating smoke test
docs: add runbook notes for enabling/disabling beta via allowlist
review_conversation: Chloe Martin (requested changes): Can we make the server authoritative for gating? I don’t want a client-only flag that could accidentally show the route chrome. Also please ensure non-allowlisted users get a deterministic response (403 vs empty state) so Support can troubleshoot.

Felix Schneider (author): Yep—updated so the BFF computes `suggestionsEnabled` and the client receives only the derived boolean. For non-allowlisted: if user has RBAC permission but not allowlisted we show the beta empty state; if they lack RBAC we return 403 and the client renders the standard permissions screen.

Kaitlyn Nguyen (requested changes): Please confirm tenant scoping on the admin mutation endpoint and add a guard so only internal admin roles can toggle. Also, log actor + workspace id on updates (we’ll need this for audit trail).

Felix Schneider (author): Added `requireInternalAdmin()` on the endpoint, ensured workspace id comes from the route param (no body-specified tenant), and added structured log fields: actor_user_id, actor_email, workspace_id, previous_value, new_value.

Ines Carvalho (comment): For control plane config, can we version the feature key name? We’ve had past issues with renames. Also TTL=60s seems ok, but we should document that enablement can take up to a minute to appear.

Felix Schneider (author): Kept the key stable (`console.features.suggestions_beta_allowlisted`) and added a comment + docs note about propagation delay. Added explicit invalidate call when toggling via admin tool (so most changes are immediate).
Dylan Brooks (approval): Looks good. Thanks for hard-gating routes and nav. The internal admin UX is minimal but sufficient for beta; we can revisit once apply workflows land.
Connor O'Brien (approval): CI green and safe for the release train. Please coordinate with releases before enabling cohort in prod.
release_notes: Console: Added `suggestions_beta` end-to-end gating (server + client) and internal per-workspace allowlist tooling to support read-only Suggestions beta rollout.
merge_summary: Merged after addressing server-authoritative gating, internal-admin RBAC checks, and adding structured logs for allowlist changes.
